objective: Move tcwine from a one-session route planner into an active wine-scene utility that earns seasonal search visits and repeat use after a tasting day.
freshnessRules: Every listed event has a named source URL and verifiedAt date.
Past events disappear from Wine Country Now automatically.
Recurring events show only their next remaining occurrence.
Official blackout rules such as LP Harvest Club Saturdays affect current-state labels.
Unpublished Old Mission event details stay in a watch state rather than being guessed.
retentionRules: Journal data stays on-device in browser local storage.
Analytics may record save/remove/status events but never tasting-note or favorite-wine text.
Every winery guide can save Want to Taste, Visited, Favorite, wine-to-remember, visit date, and tasting note.
The aggregate journal links back into winery truth pages and the planner.
searchTargets: Hunt for the Reds of October 2026
successSignals: return visits to winery detail pages
releaseBlockers: event without source or verification date
journal note content added to analytics
